skills.name: fivem-router
skills.description: Route FiveM development tasks to the minimum relevant specialist skills. Use for any FiveM resource work, feature, bug, audit, UI, networking, framework, database, gameplay, security, or performance task.

skills.name: fivem-project-inspector
skills.description: Inspect an existing FiveM project before modification. Use to identify framework, dependencies, resource boundaries, events, exports, database access, NUI stack, conventions, and risk areas.

skills.name: fivem-build
skills.description: Execute a production-minded BUILD workflow for a new FiveM feature or resource. Use when implementing new functionality end-to-end.

skills.name: fivem-fix
skills.description: Run a root-cause-first FIX workflow for FiveM bugs. Use for errors, regressions, desync, NUI failures, event failures, entity issues, database problems, or performance regressions.

skills.name: fivem-audit
skills.description: Perform a comprehensive FiveM resource audit across architecture, security, networking, performance, persistence, UI, framework compatibility, lifecycle, testing, and release readiness.

skills.name: fivem-resource-architecture
skills.description: Design and review FiveM resource architecture, fxmanifest metadata, module boundaries, exports, dependencies, lifecycle, configuration, and multi-resource composition.

skills.name: fivem-cfxlua
skills.description: Write and review modern CfxLua for FiveM using Lua 5.4 semantics, Cfx extensions, coroutine/thread patterns, efficient tables, vectors, errors, and hot-path discipline.

skills.name: fivem-native-expert
skills.description: Select, verify, and use FiveM/GTA natives correctly, including client/server context, hashes, parameters, return values, entity validity, network implications, and safer alternatives.

skills.name: fivem-client-gameplay
skills.description: Implement FiveM client gameplay systems: player/ped/vehicle interaction, cameras, animations, props, blips, markers, particles, audio, controls, and local presentation logic.

skills.name: fivem-server-authority
skills.description: Design secure server-authoritative FiveM logic for permissions, economy, inventory, ownership, proximity, cooldowns, state mutation, spawning, and validation.

skills.name: fivem-events
skills.description: Design and review FiveM local/network event contracts, handlers, callbacks, exports, cancellation, payload validation, naming, rate limits, and versioning.

skills.name: fivem-onesync
skills.description: Design OneSync-aware FiveM networking: server-created entities, network IDs, ownership migration, culling, routing buckets, population, synchronization, and large-player behavior.

skills.name: fivem-statebags
skills.description: Use FiveM state bags efficiently and safely for replicated entity/player/global attributes, including ownership, replication direction, change handlers, namespacing, and serialization cost.

skills.name: fivem-entity-lifecycle
skills.description: Manage FiveM entity lifecycle reliably across model loading, creation, networking, ownership, persistence, migration, deletion, resource stop, and player disconnect.

skills.name: fivem-routing-buckets
skills.description: Design and review routing bucket usage, population settings, entity lockdown modes, player/entity assignment, and instance teardown in OneSync.

skills.name: fivem-nui
skills.description: Build and review FiveM fullscreen NUI using CEF, `ui_page`, resource files, focus, messages, callbacks, development tooling, responsive layout, and safe teardown.

skills.name: fivem-nui-bridge
skills.description: Design typed, validated communication contracts between FiveM Lua and NUI frontends, including request/response envelopes, errors, timeouts, message routing, and rate limits.

skills.name: fivem-ui-design
skills.description: Design premium, game-first FiveM UI/UX for HUDs, menus, MDTs, phones, inventories, garages, dispatch, vehicle controls, admin tools, and custom interfaces.

skills.name: fivem-dui
skills.description: Implement and review Direct-rendered UI (DUI) for in-world screens, terminals, vehicle displays, signs, TVs, and runtime textures.

skills.name: fivem-frontend-stack
skills.description: Engineer modern FiveM NUI frontends with TypeScript and an appropriate framework/build tool while controlling bundle size, render frequency, state, accessibility, and CEF compatibility.

skills.name: fivem-database
skills.description: Design FiveM persistence with oxmysql or project-specific database libraries: queries, prepared parameters, repositories, transactions, indexes, migrations, caching, and failure handling.

skills.name: fivem-framework-adapter
skills.description: Keep FiveM resources portable across standalone, Qbox, QBCore, ESX, or custom frameworks using narrow adapter interfaces and capability detection.

skills.name: fivem-ox-ecosystem
skills.description: Integrate ox_lib, ox_target, ox_inventory, and oxmysql deliberately in FiveM resources, using current APIs and avoiding unnecessary lock-in.

skills.name: fivem-qbox
skills.description: Implement FiveM integrations for current Qbox/QBX conventions, players, jobs, groups, money, callbacks, metadata, vehicles, inventory bridges, and framework lifecycle.

skills.name: fivem-qbcore
skills.description: Implement QBCore integrations for players, jobs, money, items, metadata, callbacks, vehicles, permissions, notifications, and lifecycle using the installed server version.

skills.name: fivem-esx
skills.description: Implement ESX integrations for xPlayer, jobs, accounts, inventory, callbacks, vehicles, permissions, notifications, and lifecycle using the installed ESX version.

skills.name: fivem-vehicles
skills.description: Implement robust FiveM vehicle systems: creation, persistence, seats, doors, engine, damage, mods, extras, liveries, trailers, towing, ownership, synchronization, and cleanup.

skills.name: fivem-vehicle-ai
skills.description: Build FiveM vehicle AI for following, escort, convoy, pathfinding, driving styles, speed/gap control, recovery, obstruction handling, and player/AI handover.

skills.name: fivem-peds-ai
skills.description: Build FiveM ped AI with task sequences, follow/escort/guard/combat/flee/scenario behavior, relationships, animations, perception, networking, and cleanup.

skills.name: fivem-interactions
skills.description: Design FiveM interaction systems using targets, zones, context actions, 3D prompts, entities, and keybinds with adapters for ox_target, qb-target, or custom implementations.

skills.name: fivem-zones-raycasts
skills.description: Implement spatial queries, zones, raycasts, shape tests, line-of-sight, proximity, and world targeting efficiently in FiveM.

skills.name: fivem-input-controls
skills.description: Design FiveM keyboard/controller input, command/key mapping, control disabling, focus interactions, hold/tap behavior, and conflict-safe cleanup.

skills.name: fivem-security
skills.description: Audit and harden FiveM resources against malicious clients, forged events/callbacks, economy abuse, permission bypass, entity spoofing, replay/race attacks, SQL injection, and exposed secrets.

skills.name: fivem-performance
skills.description: Profile and optimize FiveM client/server/NUI performance: resmon, profiler, hot loops, native calls, allocations, events, state bags, entities, database queries, and frontend renders.

skills.name: fivem-debugging
skills.description: Systematically diagnose FiveM client/server/Lua/NUI/network/database/framework/resource errors and desynchronization.

skills.name: fivem-testing
skills.description: Test FiveM resources with static checks, pure-Lua unit tests, frontend tests, integration tests, in-game multi-client scenarios, restart/disconnect cases, and regression matrices.

skills.name: fivem-code-review
skills.description: Review FiveM code changes for correctness, architecture, security, networking, lifecycle, performance, persistence, UI, compatibility, and maintainability with evidence-based severity.

skills.name: fivem-observability
skills.description: Add practical FiveM observability: structured logs, debug modes, metrics/counters, event tracing, correlation IDs, diagnostics commands, and privacy-conscious telemetry.

skills.name: fivem-config-localization
skills.description: Design FiveM configuration and localization for safe defaults, environment-specific values, feature flags, locale files, validation, and backwards-compatible upgrades.

skills.name: fivem-compatibility
skills.description: Assess FiveM compatibility across server artifacts/game builds, GTA5 legacy/enhanced considerations, OneSync modes, frameworks, dependencies, and resource versions.

skills.name: fivem-release
skills.description: Prepare FiveM resources for release: versioning, changelog, migrations, dependency checks, build artifacts, packaging, upgrade notes, rollback, and release verification.

skills.name: fivem-documentation
skills.description: Write operator and developer documentation for FiveM resources: installation, dependencies, configuration, permissions, events/exports, database, UI build, troubleshooting, security, and upgrade guidance.

skills.name: fivem-resource-packaging
skills.description: Package distributable FiveM resources with clean manifests, production UI assets, licenses, source/build separation, optional escrow-aware boundaries, and no secrets or local artifacts.
